feature: FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement (candidate; untested, pending comprehensive genomic profiling)
test_name: Comprehensive genomic profiling: paired DNA + RNA NGS with structural-variant/fusion calling, MSI, and TMB (covering FGFR2, IDH1, ERBB2 copy number, BRAF V600E, KRAS G12C, NTRK1/2/3, RET)
tissue_type: archival FFPE tumor block or 10-20 unstained slides; liquid (ctDNA) acceptable as a faster parallel option when tissue is limited
rationale: No molecular profiling was supplied, so every actionable axis in this case is unmeasured; a single comprehensive DNA+RNA panel resolves seven of the eight candidate features at once and is the gate for all targeted second-line options. NCCN advises CGP at diagnosis of unresectable/metastatic biliary tract cancer, and an RNA-based fusion read matters because DNA-only calling misses a subset of FGFR2 fusions with novel or intronic breakpoints. Skipping it leaves the patient on chemotherapy alone while a roughly 40% chance of an actionable alteration goes undetected.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE block or 10-20 unstained slides; or 2 x 10 mL Streck tubes whole blood for ctDNA
decision_gated: Gates all targeted second-line therapy in metastatic CCA (FGFR, IDH1, HER2, BRAF, RET, NTRK inhibitors and pembrolizumab); rank-1 shared workup.

providers.notes: FDA-approved companion diagnostic for pemigatinib FGFR2 fusion detection in CCA; the pivotal-trial central-lab pedigree and CDx status make it the default for this gating decision. Tissue DNA panel; pair with an RNA fusion assay if FGFR2 is negative and clinical suspicion stays high.

feature: HER2 (ERBB2) amplification/overexpression (candidate; untested, pending HER2 IHC/ISH and NGS)
test_name: HER2 IHC (PATHWAY anti-HER2/neu clone 4B5) with reflex HER2 ISH
tissue_type: archival FFPE tumor block or unstained slides
rationale: NGS copy-number alone does not establish HER2 protein expression, and the approved biliary-tract HER2 agents key off a protein/ISH readout, not an amplification call: trastuzumab deruxtecan is labeled for IHC 3+, and zanidatamab eligibility was defined by ISH amplification plus IHC 2+/3+ in HERIZON-BTC-01. The PATHWAY 4B5 antibody is the FDA companion diagnostic for zanidatamab in biliary tract cancer. Without IHC/ISH, an NGS HER2 signal cannot be converted into a drug choice or the correct agent.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE block or 4-5 unstained slides
decision_gated: Zanidatamab (HERIZON-BTC-01) and trastuzumab deruxtecan (IHC 3+); selects which anti-HER2 agent applies.

providers.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories
providers.notes: Routine high-volume HER2 IHC/ISH on the 4B5 clone with fast turnaround; CAP-accredited and widely used for solid-tumor HER2 scoring, which fits a gating decision better than a send-out.

providers.name: Labcorp
providers.notes: National footprint; offers reflex FISH on equivocal IHC.

providers.name: Quest Diagnostics
providers.notes: Wide draw-site network; confirm 4B5 clone when ordering for zanidatamab eligibility.

feature: MSI-H / dMMR or high TMB (candidate; untested, pending MMR IHC, MSI assay, and NGS-derived TMB)
test_name: Mismatch-repair IHC (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2) with reflex MSI by PCR
tissue_type: archival FFPE tumor block or unstained slides
rationale: MMR protein IHC is the fastest, cheapest orthogonal readout for dMMR and catches cases an NGS-derived MSI score can miss when tumor purity is low; concordance with MSI-PCR is high but discordances occur, so the two together harden the call before committing to checkpoint blockade. The VENTANA MMR RxDx panel is an FDA companion diagnostic in the dMMR tumor-agnostic setting. MSI-H/dMMR is uncommon in biliary tract cancer (roughly 1-3%), so a confirmed positive is decision-changing and a clean negative redirects attention to the targeted axes.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE block or 4 unstained slides
decision_gated: Pembrolizumab under the MSI-H/dMMR tumor-agnostic label; orthogonal confirmation of any NGS MSI signal.

providers.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories
providers.assay_brand: MMR IHC panel with reflex MSI
providers.notes: Four-antibody MMR panel with reflex MSI-PCR run together routinely; same lab can co-process the HER2 IHC, simplifying tissue logistics.

providers.notes: Offers both MMR IHC and standalone MSI-PCR.

feature: BRAF V600E (candidate; untested, pending comprehensive genomic profiling)
test_name: BRAF V600E confirmation by NGS (or VE1 IHC screen confirmed by NGS/PCR)
tissue_type: covered by the comprehensive NGS panel; VE1 IHC as a same-block screen if a faster read is needed
rationale: VE1 IHC is a sensitive screen but is not definitive on its own; the dabrafenib/trametinib tumor-agnostic label and the ROAR biliary cohort were built on molecularly confirmed BRAF V600E, so a positive IHC needs NGS or PCR confirmation before committing. The comprehensive panel already covers this codon, so this row mainly flags that a non-V600E BRAF class-2/3 alteration would not qualify for the same regimen. Treating on an unconfirmed IHC risks exposing the patient to a doublet they cannot benefit from.
turnaround_estimate: covered within the 2-3 week CGP turnaround; VE1 IHC 3-5 days
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue if CGP is run; 1-2 unstained slides if VE1 IHC is added
decision_gated: Dabrafenib + trametinib (BRAF V600E tumor-agnostic / ROAR); distinguishes V600E from non-actionable class-2/3 BRAF.

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.notes: BRAF V600E is reported within the same comprehensive panel that gates the rest of the case; no separate order needed unless a VE1 IHC fast screen is wanted.

providers.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories

feature: IDH1 R132 mutation (candidate; untested, pending comprehensive genomic profiling)

tissue_type: covered by the comprehensive NGS panel
rationale: Ivosidenib eligibility (ClarIDHy) requires a confirmed IDH1 R132 mutation, and the codon is captured by any comprehensive DNA panel, so this is satisfied by the rank-1 CGP rather than a standalone assay. The row exists to make the IDH1 gate explicit and to note that IDH2 and non-R132 IDH1 variants do not qualify for ivosidenib. If only a limited fusion-focused panel is run, the IDH1 hotspot can be missed, so confirm DNA coverage when ordering.
turnaround_estimate: covered within the 2-3 week CGP turnaround
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue if CGP is run
decision_gated: Ivosidenib (ClarIDHy) for IDH1 R132-mutant CCA; confirms DNA hotspot coverage in the ordered panel.

feature: NTRK or RET fusion (candidate; untested, pending RNA-based fusion NGS)
test_name: RNA-based fusion NGS for NTRK1/2/3 and RET (pan-TRK IHC as an optional screen)
tissue_type: archival FFPE tumor block or unstained slides; RNA quality degrades in old blocks
rationale: NTRK and RET fusions are rare in biliary tract cancer (<1%) but tumor-agnostically actionable, and an RNA-based assay detects them more reliably than DNA-only calling, especially for partners with large intronic breakpoints. This is satisfied by the RNA arm of the rank-1 paired panel; a standalone RNA fusion test or pan-TRK IHC screen is only needed if a DNA-only platform was used. A missed fusion forecloses a high-response oral targeted option.
turnaround_estimate: covered within CGP turnaround if RNA is included; 1-2 weeks standalone
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue if paired DNA/RNA CGP is run
decision_gated: Larotrectinib/entrectinib (NTRK) and selpercatinib (RET) tumor-agnostic labels; confirms RNA fusion coverage.

feature: FGFR2 fusion/rearrangement (candidate; untested, pending comprehensive genomic profiling)
test_name: Baseline and serial ctDNA for FGFR2 kinase-domain mutations and co-altered PIK3CA / CDKN2A/B
rationale: If FGFR2 fusion is confirmed and an FGFR inhibitor is started, acquired FGFR2 kinase-domain mutations (gatekeeper N549K, V564F and others) and co-alterations such as PIK3CA or CDKN2A/B drive resistance and can prompt a switch to a next-generation FGFR inhibitor. Serial ctDNA tracks these clones earlier than imaging or re-biopsy. This is sequencing intelligence rather than an enrollment gate, so it is not essential up front, but it should be in place before or shortly after starting therapy.
tissue_required_estimate: 2 x 10 mL Streck tubes whole blood
decision_gated: Switch between FGFR inhibitors (e.g. to next-generation agents) on acquired-resistance signal; does not gate enrollment.

providers.name: Guardant Health
providers.notes: Established serial-ctDNA platform with FGFR2 resistance-mutation reporting; blood draw avoids repeat biopsy, which fits resistance monitoring.

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.notes: Liquid CDx reports FGFR2 alterations and co-mutations from plasma.

feature: MSI-H / dMMR or high TMB (candidate; untested, pending MMR IHC, MSI assay, and NGS-derived TMB)
test_name: Germline multigene panel (Lynch genes MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2/EPCAM; BRCA1/2; reflex from somatic findings)
rationale: If MMR IHC shows MLH1 loss or the somatic panel returns a pathogenic Lynch-gene or BRCA1/2 variant, germline testing distinguishes a heritable syndrome from a sporadic somatic event and triggers cascade family screening. MLH1 loss usually warrants a BRAF V600E or MLH1-promoter methylation check first to gauge whether germline testing is indicated. This does not change the patient's immediate therapy, so it is research-adjacent for the targeting question, but it carries real family implications when a driver is germline.
tissue_required_estimate: 5-10 mL whole blood or a saliva kit
decision_gated: Hereditary-syndrome diagnosis and cascade family screening; does not change current systemic therapy.

providers.name: Invitae
providers.notes: Broad hereditary-cancer panels with integrated genetic-counseling support; appropriate once a somatic or IHC finding flags possible germline origin.
